sections.Profile:
The "Cleopatra" pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in December 1977, is notable for being their first solid-state pinball machine. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison, this machine features a historical Egyptian theme. The playfield includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, three standup targets, and a five-bank drop target, providing varied gameplay.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1977–1978
